captions.instagram:
Physics, visualised #1 · Why does the moving ball stop dead? ⚪⚪

Two equal balls, one at 4 m/s, one at rest. After a perfectly elastic hit, the first one stops completely and the second leaves at 4 m/s. Watch the energy bars: it squeezes into the squash and comes straight back out.

Why? Afterwards the speeds must obey both rules at once:
momentum: vA + vB = 4 (a line)
energy: vA² + vB² = 16 (a circle)
A line meets a circle at only two points: (4, 0) is "before", (0, 4) is "after". Equal balls can only swap speeds.

JEE Main 2022 (27 June) asked it: what % of KE goes to a ball 5× heavier at rest? Share = 4mM/(m + M)² = 20/36 = 55.5% → (c).
